summary: Led a major Rails and Ruby modernisation across a large, long-lived platform. Now bringing the surrounding applications up to date and introducing modern frontend and component patterns.
Improved application performance and reliability, established automated test coverage, and helped develop core fintech workflows. Led a UI redesign through an AI-assisted delivery process.
Led a squad responsible for a large, long-running Rails platform. Helped drive the organisation's AI adoption through talks, workshops, and an agent-assisted upgrade workflow.
Kept 20+ enterprise client apps healthy under the Code Care program, raised their test coverage to 90%+, and consulted for clients including PwC and nib. Ran technical interviews as the team grew.
Built customer dashboards and documented REST APIs, and fed the production database from Redshift and Treasure Data. Ran the team's scrums and retrospectives.
Built e-commerce for Brazil's largest phone carriers, a real-time auction platform, and marketplaces with millions of items on Elasticsearch. Ported legacy apps from Rails 2.3 to Rails 4.

Released Brazil's first mobile portal the same day the first iPhone launched, and led the codebase's migration from C# to Ruby on Rails. On the side, founded Kissy, a dating app that launched before Tinder.
